derivation:
by
  apply InducedCategory.hom_ext
  exact PresheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.lift_uniq _ _ (restrictOnPreimage_range g V) arrow.hom (congrArg (fun f => f.hom) comm)
explanation: Mathlib's uniqueness theorem specializes to the restriction inclusion and the composite with g. The definition of restrictOnPreimage is precisely this lift, wrapped as a sheafed-space morphism.
